description: This file defines the UriComposer class which implements the IUriComposer interface. It constructs picture URIs based on a template and catalog base URL settings.

classes.name: UriComposer
classes.description: A class responsible for composing URIs for pictures based on provided templates and catalog settings.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder in the URI template with the actual catalog base URL from settings.
